properties.description:
Eight browser annotation corrections

1. The timeline uses the full available pane before selecting a node. Its toolbar stays outside the scrolling canvas, fresh timelines reveal their top range, and opening a detail pane keeps the selected range visible. Hidden-tab resizing and background refreshes retain the visible selection and user pan; returning from Help preserves the existing layout without detaching it.
2. File-tree expansion updates only the affected branch. The existing tree, sibling rows, editor selection and scroll remain intact, with no file reads triggered by expansion.
3. Each shared text-editor gutter fits its largest displayed line number and resizes across digit boundaries, including edited source and both diff panes.
4. Review Changes now uses the shared file-list splitter. Widths persist, and unique pane IDs keep retained file panels independent.
5. Removed the redundant truncated iteration/revision identity from the editor toolbar. The file path remains visible.
6. Added the bottom boundary beneath the All files / Modified files controls.
7. The relational engine requires explicit forward and reverse labels in both factory and raw type-registration APIs. Node type shows Has instance for incoming instances, and the self-type relation appears once.
8. Removed Incoming badges; relation labels communicate the direction.

The complete backend checkpoint exposed an existing lock-release race. A deterministic before recording confirmed that a holder could remove writer.lock between a contender's EEXIST and read, causing a false inspection error. Only this ENOENT case is now retryable; malformed, unreadable and dead-owner locks still fail closed. The retained regression passes.

The running app was checked through the user interface. Existing unsaved task fields were preserved without saving them. Human review outcomes were not changed.
